current_episode.title: The Teen Entrepreneur Revolutionising AI in Business with Rajan Randeva #189

guest.bio_context: Rajan Randeva is a 19-year-old entrepreneur who started his first dropshipping business at age 11. After finishing his GCSEs, he completed work experience with his uncle at Supply Life, a UK food and supplements brand, which inspired him to launch an Amazon affiliate marketing business that generated £300,000 in revenue over its first three months. He attended a trip to Boston with MIT and the Welsh government at age 18, and comes from an entrepreneurial family background in luxury vehicle brokerage.

context.real_quote: I started to build the Brain, which is an AI intelligence layer that sits on top of the tools that your business uses. You can ask any question — it's essentially ChatGPT for your business.
key_stats: £300,000 total revenue generated in first 3 months of Amazon affiliate marketing business (£100,000 per month)
1.8 million products indexed across Rajan's affiliate platform to date
36 active websites running simultaneously at peak of affiliate operation
Approximately 30 treadmills sold per day in December during New Year sales period
Individual websites purchased for up to $500 each for their domain authority and backlink history
95% of Rajan's professional network consists of people approximately double his age (around 38+)

pending_qa.q: Why does Rajan Randeva warn businesses against using ChatGPT or Claude with their private data?
pending_qa.r: Rajan argues that when businesses feed confidential or proprietary data into large public AI models like ChatGPT or Claude, that data effectively becomes part of the machine's training set and is no longer private. He warns that a company's intellectual property, built up over many years, is being handed over to these platforms for free. His solution with The Brain is to keep each business's data siloed and private, so it learns about that specific business without exposing it to others.

pending_qa.q: What affiliate platform partners has Rajan Randeva secured for FlexVision?
pending_qa.r: Rajan has partnered or is in the process of partnering with Amazon, Shopify, eBay, Booking.com, Expedia, and Dyson, with Louis Vuitton mentioned as a prospective partner. He also expressed a desire to eventually onboard smaller and local businesses, having originally intended to start with local businesses before going straight to Amazon. His long-term goal is to be known as someone who supported small businesses through the AI boom.

pending_qa.q: What networking experience did Rajan Randeva have at MIT in Boston and how did it shape him?
pending_qa.r: Rajan travelled alone to Boston for a trip organised with MIT and the Welsh government in November of the previous year, which he described as absolutely terrifying, including flying across the Atlantic Ocean by himself for the first time. The experience taught him that networking with older, more experienced people becomes easier with practice and that they are there to help rather than to intimidate. He estimates that 95% of his current professional network consists of people roughly double his age.

pending_qa.q: What are Rajan Randeva's exit and future plans for his businesses?
pending_qa.r: Rajan plans to exit his current businesses within the next two to three years, after which he dreams of travelling and exploring the world. From a longer-term business perspective, he is open to continuing to grow his personal brand and potentially moving into a completely different business, acknowledging that he genuinely does not know where the future will take him. He also expressed an interest in educating young people and supporting small businesses through the AI boom.
